$description: SHELTER design tokens — single source for Website, Owner Dashboard and future app (W3C DTCG). STRUCTURAL values (spacing, radius, type scale, motion, shadows, z-index, breakpoints, sizes) are technical decisions made under the owner's delegation (M29 §94, M34) and may be tuned in visual design. BRAND values (fonts, colour values) come from the old site by Owner decision D-309 (2026-10-01), replacing the wait for brand files (PO-002). The 'wireframe' values are neutral grayscale placeholders for the low-fi prototypes ONLY and must never ship.

ar.$description: Noto Kufi Arabic (SIL OFL 1.1, self-hosted from @fontsource/noto-kufi-arabic 5.3.0): Bold for headings, Light for text — the old site's GE SS Two character (D-309). Owner decision D-329 (PO-071 → C): GE SS Two returns once its web licence is confirmed. Latin glyphs inside Arabic pages fall back to Poppins.

shelter.note: Free for the web; licence text in resources/fonts/noto-kufi-arabic/OFL.txt. GE SS Two (© Boutros International) stays out of the build until its web licence is confirmed (PO-071).

en.$description: Old site accent/button font Poppins (SIL OFL 1.1, self-hosted from @fontsource/poppins 5.3.0).

base.$description: 16px — body; never smaller on mobile body copy

display.$description: 48→120px fluid — brand display (home hero wordmark) only (DS-029 type roles: Display)

normal-ar.$description: Arabic needs more vertical room for diacritics and descenders

display-en.$description: Latin display type (hero wordmark): tight, caps have no descenders

display-ar.$description: Arabic display type: room for dots and descenders

ar.$description: RULE: never letter-space Arabic — it breaks letter joining

en-display.$description: Latin display type only (optical tightening at large sizes). Never Arabic

en-eyebrow.$description: Latin ALL CAPS eyebrow labels only. Never Arabic

reading.$description: max readable line length for articles/paragraphs on desktop

space.$description: 4px base scale. margin/padding/gap use ONLY these.

radius.$description: Rounded, never harsh (owner direction). PRIMARY brand radius = md for controls; lg for cards; xl for sheets/modals.

sm.$description: badges, small chips inside dense tables

md.$description: PRIMARY — buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls (old site --ui-radius 8px, D-309)

xl.$description: bottom sheets (top corners), modals, hero media

reveal.$description: hero line reveal and section reveal on scroll (enter only, once). Exit/close always uses fast/normal (exit faster than enter)

reduced.$description: prefers-reduced-motion: instant state changes, static alternatives

modal.$description: desktop modal max width (Menu IA spec §7 product detail)

sidebar.$description: desktop side navigation width (Menu IA spec §11 side list; dashboard shell)

narrow.$description: single-task forms (owner sign-in, two-step verification, confirm identity)

stickyStack.$description: menu category + subcategory bars (R-03); short viewports keep 56px (R-09)

breakpoint.$description: Content-based (Menu IA R-01). Use container queries inside components where useful; no device-name targeting.

color.$description: Semantic roles. 'brand' = SHELTER identity from the old site (D-309): dark #131313, white headlines, greys #DDDDDE/#9A9B9C/#58595B. Every text pair ≥4.5:1, control borders ≥3:1. 'wireframe' = neutral placeholders for the low-fi prototypes only.

brand.$description: Derived one tonal step above bg for cards/panels (technical, dark-mode surface)

Old site primary colour — primary buttons and selected states
Old site button text on primary (5.2:1)

Semantic, derived for dark (≥9:1) — not a brand colour

Semantic, derived for dark (≥8:1) — not a brand colour

scrim.$description: modal/sheet backdrop; 40–60% dim (ACCESSIBILITY-CHECKLIST, confirmed in visual design)

shelter.source: Old site www.shelterjo.com (D-309, Owner 2026-10-01: "take the colours, logos and fonts from the old site — same theme")

paletteNotUsedYet.#D1345B: old site accent (3.9:1 on bg — never for text)
